name: Star Squadrons: Galactic Trading Card Game
storyline:
Humanity has expanded beyond Earth, but the frontier has become a battleground for resources, influence and control of newly discovered systems. Two major powers dominate this struggle: the United Earth Defense, representing the united Earth and its colonies, and B.E.L.T.A., a loose alliance of Free Companies, fortune seekers, scavengers, pirates and other independent groups. Although the factions within B.E.L.T.A. frequently pursue their own interests and clash with one another, they remain a powerful counterweight to the influence of the United Earth Defense.

Beyond this rivalry, the menacing Voidstalkers and their loyal Voidminions pose a growing threat to both sides. They raid settlements, plunder valuable resources and abduct humans, forcing UED and B.E.L.T.A. forces alike to confront an enemy whose motives and ambitions extend beyond their own conflicts.

In STAR SQUADRONS, players take command of a space squadron and lead the ships, pilots and tactics of their chosen faction into battle for control of contested regions across the expanding frontier.
summary: No mana. Hidden threats. Your move—even on your opponent’s turn! Command your squadron and fight for control of five locations in a tactical sci-fi trading card game. Our planned 2027 Kickstarter will let you bring your own physical tournament decks to local events.
